hero_eyebrow: Expert Garden Design & Build — Serving South Yorkshire
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete garden transformations, we design and build outdoor spaces that work for your life.
services_heading: Complete Landscape Gardening Services in Sheffield
services_subhead: We handle everything from initial design concept through to planting and ongoing maintenance — all to your budget and vision.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke garden designs tailored to your space, style, and budget. We create detailed plans so you know exactly what to expect before any work begins.

services.title: Hard Landscaping
services.desc: Professional patios, decking, raised beds, and garden structures. Built to last with quality materials and expert craftsmanship.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Thoughtful plant selection and layout that delivers colour and structure year-round. We choose plants suited to Sheffield's climate and your garden's conditions.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Prep
services.desc: We handle the heavy lifting — clearing overgrown areas, removing waste, and preparing the ground for new planting or construction.

services.title: Lawn Installation & Care
services.desc: New turf laying or seeding, plus ongoing maintenance plans to keep your lawn healthy and looking its best through every season.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular upkeep including hedge trimming, weeding, feeding, and seasonal tidying. Choose weekly, fortnightly, or monthly visits.

about_pullquote: I start by listening — your garden should reflect how you actually use your space.
about_para_1: Wildset was founded on the belief that a great garden doesn't have to cost a fortune or take months to plan. Over 15 years, we've transformed hundreds of Sheffield gardens — from small backyards to sprawling country properties. Every project starts with a conversation about your vision, your budget, and what matters most to you.
about_para_2: Our clients love working with us because we're honest, responsive, and genuinely interested in getting the details right. We don't cut corners, and we don't oversell. Whether you need a complete redesign or seasonal maintenance, you'll always get straightforward advice and a fair price. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and referrals — that's how we know we're doing something right.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Gardeners Say About Wildset

reviews.text: Wildset completely transformed our back garden. We had a rough idea of what we wanted, but Stuart and the team really helped us think it through. The finished result is stunning — we use it every single day now. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Emma T.

reviews.text: After years of having an overgrown mess, we finally bit the bullet and called Wildset. From the initial design through to final planting, it was a pleasure to work with them. They kept us updated, stuck to budget, and the quality is brilliant. Best investment we've made in the house.
reviews.author: Michael P.

reviews.text: We use Wildset for our regular garden maintenance and honestly, we wouldn't trust anyone else with it now. They're reliable, they know what they're doing, and they actually care about the garden. Fair prices too. Can't ask for more.
reviews.author: Sarah L.
